def R1Z.PV_RunJoin_OsWorld.EntropyAllowed : {E File Reply Time Worker : Type} →
  Laws E File Reply Time Worker → World E File Reply Time Worker → Fin 128 → PV_RunJoin_CallerWorld.RawReply E → Prop :=
fun {E File Reply Time Worker} laws world i reply =>
  world.entropyUsed = ↑i ∧ world.entropy i = reply ∧ laws.entropyDraw world (↑i) reply
def R1Z.PV_RunJoin_OsWorld.FileAllowed : {E File Reply Time Worker : Type} →
  [DecidableEq File] →
    Laws E File Reply Time Worker →
      World E File Reply Time Worker → Request File → Reply → World E File Reply Time Worker → Prop :=
fun {E File Reply Time Worker} [DecidableEq File] laws world request reply next =>
  fileStep request world = some (reply, next) ∧ permitted laws world request reply
def R1Z.PV_RunJoin_OsWorld.TimeAllowed : {E File Reply Time Worker : Type} →
  Laws E File Reply Time Worker → World E File Reply Time Worker → Time → World E File Reply Time Worker → Prop :=
fun {E File Reply Time Worker} laws world outcome next =>
  timeStep world = some (outcome, next) ∧ laws.time world outcome
def R1Z.PV_RunJoin_OsWorld.WorkerAllowed : {E File Reply Time Worker : Type} →
  Laws E File Reply Time Worker → World E File Reply Time Worker → Worker → World E File Reply Time Worker → Prop :=
fun {E File Reply Time Worker} laws world outcome next =>
  workerStep world = some (outcome, next) ∧ laws.worker world outcome
